main.en: A prompt agent is a saved combination of model, instructions and tools that Foundry runs for you.
main.ro: Prompt agent model, instructions aur tools ka mehfooz majmua hai jise Foundry aap ke liye chalata hai.

explain.en: Foundry Agent Service offers three agent types. Prompt agents are configured without code, the fastest way. Voice-based prompt agents talk in real time. Hosted agents run your own code as a container. For this exam, the single prompt agent is the important one.
explain.ro: Foundry Agent Service mein teen qisam ke agents hain. Prompt agents baghair code ke configure hote hain, sab se tez raasta. Voice-based prompt agents real time mein baat karte hain. Hosted agents aap ka apna code container mein chalate hain. Is exam ke liye akela prompt agent aham hai.

explain.en: Instructions describe role, scope, steps and when to use a tool. Tools give knowledge (file search, web search) or actions (code interpreter, functions, MCP servers). A toolbox bundles tools so several agents can share them.
explain.ro: Instructions role, daira, qadam aur tool kab istemal karna hai batati hain. Tools ilm (file search, web search) ya kaam (code interpreter, functions, MCP servers) dete hain. Toolbox tools ko jama karta hai taake kai agents bant sakein.

explain.en: File search splits files into chunks, creates embeddings and stores them in a vector store. At run time the agent searches it and answers with citations.
explain.ro: File search files ko chunks mein baantta, embeddings banata aur vector store mein rakhta hai. Chalte waqt agent us mein dhoond kar citations ke saath jawab deta hai.

deep.en: Instructions work best with a clear order: who you are, what you do, what you never do, when to use which tool, how to answer, what to do when you are unsure. Short sentences beat long paragraphs. If the agent picks the wrong tool, improve the description of the tool before you add more rules.
deep.ro: Instructions wazeh tarteeb mein behtar chalti hain: aap kaun hain, kya karte hain, kya kabhi nahi, kaunsa tool kab, jawab kaise, shak ho to kya. Chhote jumlay lambe paragraphs se behtar hain. Agent ghalat tool chune to usool barhane se pehle tool ki description behtar karein.

title.en: MCP: one way to connect tools
title.ro: MCP: tools jorne ka ek tareeqa

text.en: The Model Context Protocol is an open standard. The agent is the client, a service is the server, and the server tells the client which tools it offers. You connect a server once and need no special code for each service. Permissions still count: connect only servers that you trust and ask for approval before risky actions.
text.ro: Model Context Protocol open standard hai. Agent client hai, service server hai, aur server client ko batata hai kaunse tools deta hai. Server ek dafa jorte hain, har service ka khaas code nahi chahiye. Ijazatein phir bhi aham hain: sirf bharose wale servers jorein aur khatre wale kaam se pehle manzoori lein.

title.en: Foundry IQ: shared knowledge for agents
title.ro: Foundry IQ: agents ki mushtarka maloomat

text.en: Foundry IQ is a managed knowledge layer on top of Azure AI Search. You create a knowledge base for a business domain, add knowledge sources (Blob Storage, SharePoint, OneLake, web, a search index), and connect it to agents as an MCP tool. It does chunking, embeddings and indexing, and it respects permissions.
text.ro: Foundry IQ Azure AI Search ke upar managed knowledge layer hai. Ek karobari domain ka knowledge base banate, knowledge sources (Blob Storage, SharePoint, OneLake, web, search index) jorte aur usay MCP tool ke taur par agents se jorte hain. Chunking, embeddings aur indexing woh karta hai, aur ijazatein manta hai.

text.en: Agentic retrieval breaks a complex question into subqueries, searches several sources, ranks the results and returns citations. The instructions still have to say when to use the knowledge, how to cite it and what to do when evidence is missing. The module was last updated in November 2026, so learn it after the core topics.
text.ro: Agentic retrieval pecheeda sawal ko subqueries mein baantti, kai sources mein talash karti, nateeje rank karti aur citations deti hai. Instructions ko phir bhi batana hai ke maloomat kab istemal ho, kaise cite ho aur saboot na ho to kya ho. Module November 2026 mein update hua, is liye bunyadi topics ke baad seekhein.

text.en: A voice agent listens, reasons and speaks. Its instructions have five parts: personality, environment, tone, goal and guardrails. Spoken answers must be short, with one question at a time, because callers cannot scroll back.
text.ro: Voice agent sunta, sochta aur bolta hai. Us ki instructions ke paanch hissay hain: personality, environment, tone, goal aur guardrails. Bole gaye jawab chhote hon aur ek waqt mein ek sawal, kyunke caller wapas scroll nahi kar sakta.

text.en: A native speech-to-speech model works with the audio itself. A text model uses a chain: recognition, answer, synthesis. Test with real speech: typed questions do not test timing and pronunciation.
text.ro: Native speech-to-speech model audio par hi kaam karta hai. Text model chain istemal karta hai: recognition, jawab, synthesis. Asal awaaz se test karein: type kiye sawal timing aur talaffuz test nahi karte.

text.en: Decides when the caller has finished. Azure semantic uses meaning; Basic uses volume and silence duration.
text.ro: Tay karti hai caller ki baat kab khatam hui. Azure semantic matlab istemal karti hai; Basic volume aur silence duration.

text.en: Short words during a wait. They do not mean success.
text.ro: Intezar ke dauran chhote alfaaz. Kamyabi ka matlab nahi.

text.en: Too long → instructions. Interrupts → turn detection. Unclear → voice. Silence during a tool → interim response.
text.ro: Bohat lamba → instructions. Baat kaatta hai → turn detection. Na-samajh → awaaz. Tool par khamoshi → interim response.

how.en: Start with one tool and add more only when a test needs it.
how.ro: Ek tool se shuru karein, aur tab barhayein jab test ko zaroorat ho.

how.en: Test questions that it must refuse, not only the easy ones.
how.ro: Woh sawal bhi test karein jin se inkaar karna hai, sirf aasan nahi.

how.en: Look at the tool calls in the playground: did it search, and with which words?
how.ro: Playground mein tool calls dekhein: kya us ne talash ki, aur kin alfaaz se?

how.en: Require human approval for actions that change data or cost money.
how.ro: Data badalne ya paise lagne wale kaam ke liye insani manzoori lazmi karein.

text.en: An HR agent: instructions "Answer only from the HR files; otherwise say you do not know", file search with 12 policies, code interpreter for vacation days. Test: "How many days after 3 years?" uses both tools; "Who wins the match?" is refused.
text.ro: HR agent: instructions "Answer only from the HR files; otherwise say you do not know", 12 policies wala file search, chhuttiyon ke hisaab ke liye code interpreter. Test: "3 saal baad kitne din?" dono tools; "Match kaun jeetega?" par inkaar.

wrong.ro: "Instructions file search ki jagah le sakti hain."

right.en: Sixty documents do not fit, and they change.
right.ro: Saath documents nahi aate, aur woh badalte hain.

right.en: Extra tools add risk and wrong choices.
right.ro: Izafi tools khatra aur ghalat intikhab barhate hain.

text.en: Prompt agent: configuration, run by Foundry. Hosted agent: your own code in a container.
text.ro: Prompt agent: configuration, Foundry chalata hai. Hosted agent: aap ka apna code container mein.

text.en: File search reads your documents; web search reads current public pages.
text.ro: File search aap ke documents parhta hai; web search taza awami pages.

exam.en: Need → tool: documents, exact math, current information, own function.
exam.ro: Zaroorat → tool: documents, bilkul sahi hisaab, taza maloomat, apna function.

exam.en: Why does it invent answers? Usually no knowledge tool or no instruction to use it.
exam.ro: Jawab kyun gharta hai? Aksar ilm wala tool nahi, ya us ke istemal ki hidayat nahi.
